dates: 1849/50-1925
---

brother of Emmeline Spratt

Nephew of CMY\'s maid Harriet Spratt, he was a chorister at Winchester College.

In the 1871 census he was working as a shop assistant in a large shop in the Edgware Road in London; by 1891 he was a draper on his own account.
